weaknesses: Wrong state wage base for nonresident sourcing: used W-2 box 16 (the PA base, incl. 401(k) deferrals) for MA instead of MA wages (box 1 - MA excludes 401(k) deferrals). One upstream base error cascaded into MA tax, PA G-L credit, PA refund and local credit - state workpapers need a per-state wage-base reconciliation step.
Software-exception log omits 'negative' exceptions (returns the software would wrongly generate - NJ/IL) even though the state analysis got them right.
Self-review by the same agent did not catch the wage-base error (reviewer re-derived workdays but not the base).

eval_feedback.overall: Update the key's NIIT: Reg. 1.1411-4(f)(3)(iii) permits state income tax allocable to NII on Form 8960 line 9b (limited to the amount deductible after the 164(b)(6) SALT cap). With itemized deductions and a $10,000 capped SALT, an allocation of ~$590 gives NIIT ~$2,048, total tax $140,052, refund $717. The key's $2,070 / $695 should be revised (or accept a range). Also consider adding the PA local EIT final return (Act 32 annual filing) to required_filings.
